description: U.S. Air Traffic by Airport and Carrier, 1990-2026 (BTS T-100, aggregated) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Denys Kolomiiets (FlightFinder (himaxym.com)). The U.S. air travel market in tidy CSVs, aggregated from BTS T-100 segment data: national passengers (domestic/international), flights, seats and load factor 1990 through mid-2026; per-airport passenger series for 653 airports; per-carrier series for 167 airlines; and the 25 busiest domestic city-pairs of 2025. Compiled by FlightFinder; explorer at himaxym.com/traffic. Also on Kaggle: kaggle.com/datasets/himaxym/us-air-traffic-t100. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
